PART III – GAZETTE EXTRAORDINARY OF THE DEMOCRATIC SOCIALIST REPUBLIC OF SRI LANKA – 28.03.2019
PRINTED AT THE DEPARTMENT OF GOVERNMENT PRINTING, SRI LANKA.
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, hereby declare, under Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the servitude described below is required for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of that Act. Column 11 details The land from which the said condition is achieved.

1. Description of the Servitude.– Acquiring the Right of Servitude of a portion of land for Thalatuoya Service Reservoir of Kundasale Haragama Water Supply project and access road of the pump house and plumbing.

2. Description of the Servitude.– Boundaries of the allotments of land consist with following names and extents shown as in detail in the Advanced Tracing No. Maha/PTH/2020/679 dated 02.02.2021, prepared by the Surveyor- General and situated in the Kadakula Village in Grama Niladhari Division of Bootawatta North (984) in the Pathahewaheta Divisional Secretary's Division of Kandy District in Central Province:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta – Extent: 0.0548 Hectare North: Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by B.G.Warnakulasooriya and others and the road (R.D.A.); East: Road (R.D.A.) and Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal

Watta claimed by G.M.H.V. Ajantha Lakshman and others; South: Naranka duwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by G.M.H.V. Ajantha Lakshman and others, Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by D.A. Perera; West: Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by B.G.Warnakulasooriya and others.

02. Lot ‘B’ – Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta – Extent: 0.0133 Hectare North: Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by B.G.Warnakulasooriya and others and the road; East: Road and Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by D.A. Perera; South: Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by D.A. Perera; West: Narankaduwa Watta alias Kaliyapperumal Watta claimed by B.G.Warnakulasooriya and others.
K.D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
